tools.name: search_catalogue
tools.description: Search published Collectorists catalogue records (coins, trading cards, sports cards, stamps, LEGO® sets and other toys, comics, sealed products) by words. Returns each match's title, type, a few identifying facts and its page on collectorists.com. Returns no prices, listings or images.

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: The facts and description of one published catalogue record, by the slug in its collectorists.com address (/catalogue/{slug}). Coins: year, monarch, denomination, strike, metal, fineness, weight, diameter, mintage or edition limit. LEGO® sets: number, theme, pieces, minifigures, retirement status, U

tools.name: identify_coin
tools.description: The British coins we catalogue for one denomination and year, so a holder can tell which one they have. Denomination as written on or said of the coin, e.g. "50p", "£2", "shilling", "half crown", "sovereign".

tools.name: lego_retirement
tools.description: Whether a LEGO® set is on sale at LEGO.com, expected to retire (an estimate from Brickset, labelled as such), retired, or no longer made, by its set number, e.g. "75192" or "10497-1".

tools.name: set_checklist
tools.description: Every published record in one set, collection or range, by name, each with its page on collectorists.com. The slug is the last part of the set page address, e.g. "beatrix-potter-50p" for a coin collection.
